scope: Expense source only; issue3 first source stage
execution_topology: Fresh Python venv -> unittest fixtures / observer -> owned temporary SQLite files and loopback ephemeral HTTP -> real Chromium; app restart uses explicit same owned file and separately tracked processes. No target/shared DB.
db_connection_identity_ready: SQLite paths constructed only below each TemporaryDirectory; read snapshots use mode=ro on that existing path
transaction_fixture_order_ready: Existing ExpenseStore commits request writes; observation snapshots begin a read-only SQLite transaction after synchronous HTTP completion
failure_order_rehearsed: Wrong source revision/dirty tracked bytes reject before DB allocation; existing output rejects before observation; actual role and stale-revision negatives run after correct pending/submitted setup
cleanup_plan_ready: HTTP/browser/app contexts finally-close; TemporaryDirectory removes owned DB files; publication preserves existing output and removes its partial file
